{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Sergey S. Kislitsyn''', ({{langx|ru|Серге́й Серге́евич Кисли́цын}}) is a Russian mathematician, specializing in [[combinatorics]] and [[coding theory]].

Kislitsyn was born January 5, 1935, in [[Ivanovo]], [[Soviet Union]].  He received his M.S. in mathematics from [[Saint Petersburg State University|Leningrad State University]] in 1957. From 1962 until 1970 he worked at Yekaterinburg branch of the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]] ({{ill|Krasovsky Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics|ru|Институт_математики_и_механики_имени_Н._Н._Красовского_УрО_РАН}}). He defended his Ph.D. thesis in 1964 and continued working as a lecturer at [[Krasnoyarsk State University]].<ref>{{cite book |url=https://umj.uran.ru/list_1975/List.pdf |pages=87–89 |language=ru |chapter=Кислицын Сергей Сергеевич |title=Биобиблиографический Указатель Научных Трудов Сотрудников Института Математики и Механики УрО РАН до 1975 г |trans-title=Bio-Bibliographic Index of Scientific Works of Employees of the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics UB RAS before 1975 |volume=1 |publisher=Ural Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences |location=Yekaterinburg, Russia |year=2010}}</ref>

Kislitsyn is known for posing the [[1/3–2/3 conjecture]] for [[linear extension]]s of finite [[Partially ordered set|posets]], which he published in 1968.<ref>{{cite journal
 | last = Kislitsyn | first = S. S.
 | doi = 10.1007/BF01111312
 | issue = 5
 | journal = [[Mathematical Notes]]
 | pages = 798–801
 | title = A finite partially ordered set and its corresponding set of permutations
 | volume = 4
 | year = 1968| s2cid = 120228193
 }}</ref> The conjecture is established in several special cases but open in full generality.<ref>{{cite journal
 | last1 = Olson | first1 = Emily J.
 | last2 = Sagan | first2 = Bruce E.
 | doi = 10.1007/s11083-017-9450-3
 | issue = 3
 | journal = Order
 | mr = 3861401
 | pages = 581–596
 | title = On the 1/3–2/3 conjecture
 | volume = 35
 | year = 2018| s2cid = 52965439
 | arxiv = 1706.04985
 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last=Brightwell |first=Graham |date=1999-04-28 |title=Balanced pairs in partial orders |journal=Discrete Mathematics |language=en |volume=201 |issue=1 |pages=25–52 |doi=10.1016/S0012-365X(98)00311-2 |issn=0012-365X|doi-access= }}</ref>
